_comment: EPISODE 2, TAKE C of three. THE PAYOFF, and ANSWERS ONLY like take B: shot 1 is `handover_cold` and generation.answers_only is set, so the interviewer's question is asked once in the whole episode, in take A. It has to be last: brandkit.validate requires the `payoff` shot to end a config with this role, and build_episode.py requires exactly one payoff take and requires it to be the last one. The last person drinks and finds out it is water, which is the joke and the only reason the episode exists. product and location are IDENTICAL BYTE FOR BYTE with takes A and B. The backpack from episode 1 is gone: it rendered with garbled lettering across it.
